ClimbPunchingImgs.name: Mario climbing, tile and position tables
summary: Starts with the tables and the second half of Mario's climbing code. $00DB17 (entered with a JMP from CODE_00CD76): climbing a net or vine.
Handles the net door punch/spin ([$149D], [$1878]), jumping off with B, punching the net with A (swaps sides), left/right/up/down
movement from the controller, and the climbing animation flip. Stops climbing by clearing [RAM_IsClimbing] ($00DC00).
$00DC2D: moves Mario by his speed without gravity (Y speed saved in [$8A], wall running swaps the axes). Calls $00DC4F once per axis.
$00DC4F: adds speed * 16 to the position fraction [$13DA,X], then the whole pixels (sign extended, carry included) to [$94,X].
Parameters ($00DC4F): X = 0 for X axis, 2 for Y axis.

NumWalkingFrames.name: Tables: walk animation and tile layouts
summary: NumWalkingFrames: frames per walk cycle by powerup. DATA_00DC7C: walk animation timer by speed (rows of 8).
DATA_00DCEC / DD32 / DD4E / DE32: Mario tile layout, an index per Mario image selects the first entry in the X/Y offset tables used
by the Mario draw routine at $00E2BD (words, signed, relative to Mario's screen position).

TilesetIndex.name: Table: tileset offset by powerup
summary: Added to Mario's image number by powerup (small, big, cape, fire) before the tile table lookups. Not used for images >= $3D.

TileExpansion?.name: Table: image to 8x8 tile set
summary: Maps image (plus tileset offset) to an index into Mario8x8Tiles (4 bytes per set). Mostly 0.

Mario8x8Tiles.name: Table: Mario OAM tile numbers
summary: Sets of four tiles: 16x16 upper, 16x16 lower, two extra 8x8 tiles ($80 = not drawn). The cape set ($2C) starts at $00E006.
Followed by DATA_00E00C and DATA_00E0CC: the upper and lower body graphic tile numbers per image, used by the Mario GFX DMA code.

MarioPalIndex.name: Mario OAM drawing and cape data tables, draw routine
summary: MarioPalIndex: OAM X flip bit by direction. DATA_00E18E..E266: cape tile data and layouts. DATA_00E292: invincibility flash masks.
DATA_00E2A2: Mario/Luigi palette pointers by powerup (entries 4-7 cycle for the star). DATA_00E2B2..E2B9: OAM offsets and priority.
$00E2BD (called with JSL from banks 01, 02, 04, 0C): Mario graphics. Handles Yoshi, star and power-up palette flashing, the star
timer and its music restore, invincibility flicker, then writes Mario's OAM tiles (four body tiles plus up to three cape tiles) and
ends with CODE_00F636 (Mario graphics DMA setup). $00E45D: adds one tile at OAM offset Y from tile set [$06] and offsets [$05].

s00E4DA.name: Table: max Y speed on slope

s00E53D.name: Tables: slope push and step profiles
summary: Slope X speed push (signed) by slope type, followed by slope step profiles, read by Mario's block interaction code.

s00E632.name: Table: slope ground height
summary: 16 bytes per slope type: ground height at each pixel column of the tile. Indexed by (slope type * 16) + X within the tile.

s00E830.name: Table: Mario collision point X offsets
summary: Words, four per set; added to Mario's X position by CODE_00F44D to place the layer collision points.

s00E89C.name: Table: Mario collision point Y offsets
summary: Words, four per set; added to Mario's Y position by CODE_00F44D. DATA_00E8A4 is also read at $00EBA8.

s00E90A.name: Table: side blocked bits and pushes

s00E91F.name: Table: tile push Y offsets
summary: Words by (tile - $CC) * 2: Y offsets applied to Mario every 4th frame (CODE_00EFBC, tiles $CE-$D1).

lines.00DADD: $1E / $23: Mario image while punching a net: [in front, behind]
lines.00DADF: Net door spin: X speed by |[$1878]| (index 0-17)
lines.00DAF1: Net door spin: word added to X speed/fraction [$7A] by |[$1878]| * 2
lines.00DB17: Entry (from CODE_00CD76): Mario is climbing a net or vine. Not flying
lines.00DB31: Yes: skip the speed override, go to $00DB45
lines.00DB3D: / Negate the speed for a negative position
lines.00DB51: Carry = sign: set means add the table word
lines.00DB78: A = Mario image from DATA_00DACD[Y] (net punch frames)
lines.00DB81: X = [$13F9] (Mario is behind scenery: 0 front, 1 behind)
lines.00DB8A: } A = X + 2: index for the cape/punch hitbox
lines.00DB98: N = bit 7 of [$16] (B newly pressed), V = bit 6 (A newly pressed)
lines.00DBA3: / Mario Y speed = DATA_00DABB[Y] (jump: $B0 land, $F0 water)
lines.00DBB4: / Play sound effect ($1DF9 = 1): punch the net
lines.00DBC3: Mario direction = A (facing depends on net column)
lines.00DBCD: / Mario image = ClimbingImgs[X] (front or behind net)
lines.00DBDE: / Bits 3 and 4 both set? Yes: go move at $00DBE8
lines.00DBE2: / Vine (bit 7 clear): stop climbing, go to $00DC00
lines.00DBFE: / Down: shift [$8B]; carry set: go to $00DC0B
lines.00DC0D: Net (bit 7): keep X speed, go to $00DC11
lines.00DC16: A = Y speed | X speed (also true when no key pressed)
lines.00DC36: Carry = bit 0 of wall run status
lines.00DC3E: Wall run: Mario Y speed = +/- X speed
lines.00DC42: / Move X: add speed to X position (X = 0)
lines.00DC47: / Move Y: add speed to Y position (X = 2)
lines.00DC78: Number of walking animation frames by powerup
lines.00DC7C: Walk animation timer by speed index: rows of 8, slowest to fastest
lines.00DCEC: Mario image to tile layout index (even index into DATA_00DD32)
lines.00DD32: Mario tile layout: byte offset of first tile in the position tables (per layout, facing)
lines.00DD4E: Mario tile X offsets (words, signed), 2 bytes per tile
lines.00DE32: Mario tile Y offsets (words, signed), 2 bytes per tile
lines.00DF16: Tileset index offset added to Mario frame by powerup (small, big, cape, fire)
lines.00DF1A: Mario image to first 8x8 tile set (index into Mario8x8Tiles, 4 per set)
lines.00DFDA: Mario 8x8 tile sets: 16x16 upper, 16x16 lower, two extras ($80 = unused)
lines.00E00C: Mario image to upper-body graphics tile (for Mario GFX DMA, [$0A])
lines.00E0CC: Mario image to lower-body graphics tile (for Mario GFX DMA, [$0B])
lines.00E18C: OAM property bits by direction: no flip, X flip
lines.00E18E: Mario image to index into cape tile data (DATA_00E1D4)
lines.00E1D4: Cape tile data: [skip first cape tile flag]
lines.00E1D5: Cape tile data: cape tile set / image base ($0C)
lines.00E1D6: Cape tile data: layout index ($05 base)
lines.00E1D8: Cape tile data: groups; byte for [$0E] is the third cape tile set
lines.00E21A: Cape tile layout: byte offset in Mario tile position tables, by (index | direction)
lines.00E23A: Cape tile set per cape image ([$13DF]) * 4 | base
lines.00E266: Cape layout index per cape image ([$13DF]) * 4 | base
lines.00E2A2: Mario palette ROM pointers (bank $00): by powerup*2 + player; entries 4-7 cycle for the star
lines.00E2B2: OAM buffer offset of Mario's tiles: in front, behind scenery
lines.00E2B6: OAM buffer offset of the cape tiles: in front, behind scenery
lines.00E2C4: / [$78] = $FF: Mario fully hidden, skip Yoshi handling
lines.00E2C6: Handle Yoshi if Mario is riding (CODE_01EA70)
lines.00E2CD: Non-zero (power-up flash): go to palette cycling at $00E308
lines.00E2D2: No star: use the normal palette
lines.00E2D8: / Mario hidden: do not count down the star timer
lines.00E301: / P-switch/coin timers all zero: keep music in X
lines.00E33D: Shift right: carry for the position subtraction
lines.00E344: / [$7E] = Mario X position - screen X (X on screen)
lines.00E35D: / Image >= $0A: skip compare, else compare Y with [$13DB]
lines.00E381: / Flash mask & timer, | sprites locked | frozen: non-zero draws
lines.00E391: / Image $29: check powerup, else go to $00E399
lines.00E3C5: / X = [$13F9]; in front of scenery: keep A
lines.00E3E1: } Set OAM properties of six of Mario's slots
lines.00E3EA: Otherwise toggle X flip for slot 3
lines.00E443: Bit 7 of the data set: skip the first cape tile
lines.00E458: Set up Mario graphics DMA tile addresses (CODE_00F636)
lines.00E45F: / Next bit of tile mask [$78] set: skip this tile
lines.00E4A2: } X = Y / 4: OAM size table index
lines.00E4B9: Slope steepness code stored in [$13E1], by slope type
lines.00E4DA: Max Y speed on slope, by slope type
lines.00E4FB: Launch Y speed when running fast into slope, by type
lines.00E53D: Slope X speed push (signed), 0 = flat, by slope type
lines.00E632: Slope ground height by (slope type * 16 + pixel column), 16 bytes per slope
lines.00E830: Mario collision point X offsets (words), 4 per set
lines.00E89C: Mario collision point Y offsets (words), 4 per set
lines.00E8A4: Mario collision point Y offsets (words), continued; read separately
lines.00E90D: Word X push per side: -1, +1 (also sign table)
lines.00E002: Last small sets; $E006 starts the cape set ($2C): $04,$7F,$4A,$5B
